basis: Q3 operating evidence strengthened while trailing P/E had expanded to about 30.8x.
2025 earnings and margins were strong, but trailing P/E near 32x meant a larger portion of future success was priced in.

The 2026-08-18 regular-session close of $413.41 entered the $395-$420 first-accumulation/buy-review zone and was about 13.7% below the $478.89 52-week high. These are re-underwrite triggers, not automatic trade instructions.
sizing: No automatic full-size entry. If no position and portfolio risk permits, a small research sleeve can be justified after confirming the operating thesis, EPS/guidance trajectory and upstream AI demand remain intact; larger sizing requires either a deeper valuation reset with thesis intact or a fresh fundamental upgrade that raises expected value.
add_triggers: material price/multiple reset with AI/HPC demand, technology execution, margin framework and geopolitical operations intact
revenue/EPS guidance or upstream hyperscaler capex evidence rises enough to improve expected return despite price
trim_triggers: multiple expands materially faster than earnings estimates
expected return compresses without new evidence

high capex plus falling utilization/revenue guidance and deteriorating FCF

add_conditions: Price enters 370-395 with thesis and EPS/guidance intact
FY2027/FY2028 earnings power rises enough to increase expected return despite a higher price
N2/A16/advanced-packaging execution and hyperscaler real-compute demand strengthen
trim_conditions: Price/multiple outruns EPS revisions and base-case 24m annualized expected return compresses below the portfolio hurdle
AI/semiconductor factor concentration exceeds portfolio limit
upstream demand remains strong but TSM-specific margin/capital productivity deteriorates
kill_criteria: multi-quarter AI/HPC demand deterioration plus material customer real-compute capex cuts
structural N2/A16/advanced-packaging execution or major customer/design loss
persistent margin impairment without credible recovery
high capex with falling utilization/guidance and deteriorating FCF
verified geopolitical impairment of production/logistics/export/market access
